data.description:
## Incident Overview

review-sub-pr.yml:42 pipes diff directly to ci-llm-review-runner.sh via stdin, bypassing llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh. No provenance verification, no OVER_BOUND gate, no Strategy F region-split for large story diffs.

**Fix**: Route through llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh or add a size guard.
**Probe**: Create story PR with 10K+ line diff, verify region-split does not activate.
data.title: ci: review-sub-pr.yml pipes diff via stdin bypassing provenance and Strategy F
